name: team
description: Project teammates (ADR 0031): a named, persistent agent per role per project, a notes file that is its memory of record, and a serial inbox any session in the project summons it through.

tips.text: Send work to a teammate from the terminal: `vyre team ask design "Make the estate intake calmer"`.
tips.command: vyre team ask design "Make the estate intake calmer"

tips.text: See this project's teammates, their state and queue with `vyre team`.
Give the project a teammate: `vyre team add design --brief "visual design and UI copy"`.
tips.command: vyre team add design --brief "visual design and UI copy"

tips.text: A request that cannot wait: `vyre team ask design "..." --urgent`. It jumps its teammate's own queue, never the box-wide slot queue.
